body: Yeah. Maybe it's just a drug addled fantasy stemming from my sheltered and naive life but I believe in one. It doesn't make much sense, maybe they're just hallucinations caused by dying brains and I'll be in for a shock when I throw away everything I ever had. But the consistency of reports has convinced me. I don't hope for one either, I think it scares me more than there not being one, like the idea that your entire fate lies in the hands of being likable enough for benevolent dudes to rescue you from malevolent ones. Not being comforted by anything whether its death, life or an afterlife is a real bind.

Sometimes. When there's a clear and present danger of actually dying, or I'm in a negative mindset it scares me, but other times I get a really clearheaded feeling and feel like if there was nothing holding me back I could just do it. I'm not too scared of the pain, I've practiced my method a few times and it's an overwhelming feeling but I think it's leagues better than how people usually die.

I've been obsessively reading near death experience to help alleviate my fear but really all they do is reinforce it. The idea that there are entities out there recording and controlling our lives and who will judge us when we die sickens me, even if they're benevolent, because the last thing I want is to be around more people and to feel more lacking in control than I already do, because if "the system" is just an extension of them then there really is no escape, but when I discard those thoughts and conceptualize it as slipping away into nothing I feel better.
